messages:
Maya (Product): Quick qtr-okr check — compact update on the Runtime & infra milestone. Please reply with owner + ETA if something slipped. TL;DR: streaming API GA shipped, quantization rollout slipped due to kernel regressions, infra scheduler might be related. Details and asks below.
Alex (Eng Lead): Shipped: streaming API GA merged + docs updated. PR #647. Verified perf in staging. :tada:
Sam (Runtime): Confirm streaming GA ✔️. Noted quant rollout still pending. Will estimate.
Maya (Product): Quantization rollout (Q2: model perf + int8 path) slipped — root cause appears to be packing regressions when int8 kernels run on A100. Owner: Sam. Can you post a short remediation plan?
Sam (Runtime): Plan: 1) add targeted regression unit tests, 2) repro on staging with debug kernels, 3) either patch kernel or revert the offending PR. ETA: EOW (Fri) for a clear rollback-or-fix decision.
Jin (Infra): @Sam infra note — we flipped scheduler tuning last week (padding optimization). That could change batch padding behavior and surface the regressions. I can revert the scheduler on staging for a repro. Ping me when you want that.
Sam (Runtime): Thanks @Jin — will repro on staging Tue AM. Please keep staging capacity at 4 GPUs for the run.
Olivia (QA): FYI QA found a stable failure in large-batch streaming when KV cache miss rate >30%. Filing bug with repro steps now (link in ticket). Assigning to Sam + QA to verify once patch is up.
Taylor (Eng PM): Owners for cross-team dependencies: infra -> Jin, runtime -> Sam, docs -> Alex, QA -> Olivia. If anyone needs to hand off, call it out here. Also callout: code review backlog — 3 PRs blocking canary (#652, #659, #663).
Alex (Eng Lead): I'll take #652 (docs + changelog). Sam should pick #659 (runtime). Jin please look at #663 (scheduler tweak).
Sam (Runtime): Picking #659 now. Heads-up: ~10 LOC but touches kernel launch path and needs perf smoke tests.
Jin (Infra): I'll triage #663 today. If it's a revert we'll need a rollback window Thu 1-3pm PST to minimize customer impact.
Maya (Product): Decision threshold: if fix not in by Thu EOD, we roll canary back and move quantization to next sprint. Owners please ack so I can update the OKR tracker.
Alex (Eng Lead): :thumbsup: ack. I'll finish the docs PR by Wed.
Sam (Runtime): Ack. Will post a short status update after Tue repro and attach logs.
Olivia (QA): QA will schedule a regression run Wed night and report results by Wed 11pm PST.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: canary build 2026.05.12-rc3 queued for staging at 2026-05-12T02:00Z
Maya (Product): Thanks all. I'll post this as the OKR milestone update in the tracker and tag owners. If anything changes after the Wed runs, drop a quick note here and I’ll capture it in the sprint plan. —Maya
